item.title: Suryakumar Yadav Powers India to 161/9 Against USA in Thrilling T20 World Cup Encounter
item.description: Suryakumar Yadav starred with 84* off 49 balls, rescuing India from early collapses against the USA, guiding them to 161/9 with audacious strokes, smart running, and composure under pressure in a thrilling T20 World Cup clash.

item.title: Dry spell to end soon as Western disturbance brings snowfall to Himalayas; Check report here
item.description: India is set to witness largely dry weather for the next two days before a fresh western disturbance brings rain and snowfall to the western Himalayan region. Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand may see precipitation between February 9 and 11, along with fog-related travel disruptions.

item.title: Russia hostel knife attack injures 4 Indian students; Embassy steps in
item.description: A knife attack at a state medical university in Ufa, Russia, left four Indian students among several injured after a teenage assailant stormed a hostel dormitory. The Indian Embassy confirmed medical treatment for the victims and is coordinating with local authorities.

item.title: Missed the match? Here’s how Suryakumar Yadav led India to victory against USA
item.description: India kicked off their T20 World Cup 2026 campaign with a convincing 29-run victory over the United States at Wankhede Stadium. Captain Suryakumar Yadav played a match-winning unbeaten knock of 84 runs, rescuing India after an early collapse and guiding the team to 161/9.

item.title: PM Modi calls India-Malaysia partnership historic during bilateral talks; Full details
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, on his Malaysia visit, described India-Malaysia ties as historic and steadily expanding across sectors such as trade, technology, defence, clean energy and semiconductors.

item.title: ‘Is Trump India’s Petroleum Minister?’ Owaisi targets Centre over US threat
item.description: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi sharply criticized US President Donald Trump’s warning of tariffs on India for buying Russian oil. Addressing a rally in Karimnagar, he questioned whether India’s policies were being dictated from Washington and accused the Centre of failing to defend national sovereignty.

item.title: Is this the right time to invest in Gold and Silver again? Here’s what experts say
item.description: Gold and silver prices, after hitting record highs, are witnessing sharp volatility and recent declines, leaving investors uncertain about the right strategy. Experts suggest staying calm, avoiding panic selling, and keeping a balanced 10–15% allocation in precious metals for long-term gains.

item.title: Punjab Government suspends 2 senior IAS Officers over Anganwadi scam; Details here
item.description: Punjab government has suspended two senior IAS officers, Kamal Kishore Yadav and Jaspreet Singh, over the Anganwadi smartphone scam. The delay in providing devices to Anganwadi workers sparked administrative action under the All India Services (Discipline &#38; Appeal) Rules, 1969.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: After Bumrah, another star Indian batsman falls sick; Details here
item.description: During India’s opening T20 World Cup 2026 match against USA, young opener Abhishek Sharma fell ill mid-game and had to leave the field. Despite the setback, India managed a 29-run win, led by Suryakumar Yadav’s stellar performance.
